page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-64 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 504.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 7.88 GB per core.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the c4d-highmem-64 does not feature any integrated graphics processing units and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile offers a high density of memory relative to the dedicated compute cores, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require substantial memory footprints without the overhead of GPU accelerators or local NVMe drives. Appropriate workloads for this instance include large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
